summary: Custom Role Manager testing completed successfully. All backend APIs (15/15 tests passed) and frontend UI features working correctly. RBAC properly enforced - team members cannot create/edit/delete roles.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/roles/permissions returns all permissions grouped by category (41 permissions in 10 categories)
Backend: GET /api/roles/org/{org_id} returns built-in roles (5) and custom roles
Backend: POST /api/roles/org/{org_id} creates a new custom role with name, description, permissions, color
Backend: PUT /api/roles/{role_id} updates an existing custom role
Backend: DELETE /api/roles/{role_id} deletes a custom role
Backend: Team member gets 403 when trying to create role (RBAC enforced)
Backend: Team member gets 403 when trying to update role (RBAC enforced)
Backend: Team member gets 403 when trying to delete role (RBAC enforced)
Backend: Duplicate role name validation returns 400
Backend: Invalid permission validation returns 400
Backend: Delete nonexistent role returns 404
Frontend: Settings > Roles tab displays built-in roles with member counts
Frontend: Settings > Roles tab displays custom roles (QA Tester, Designer)
Frontend: Create Custom Role button opens dialog with name, color, description, permissions accordion
Frontend: Permissions can be selected by category with Select All checkbox
Frontend: Edit button on custom roles opens edit dialog with existing data
Frontend: Duplicate button creates a copy of a role with '(Copy)' suffix
Frontend: Delete button removes a custom role
Frontend: Team member does NOT see Create Custom Role button (RBAC enforced)
Frontend: Team member does NOT see Edit/Delete/Duplicate buttons on roles (RBAC enforced)
updated_files: /app/tests/test_role_management.py - Created comprehensive Role Management API test file
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_AutomatedRole during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom Role Manager is fully implemented and working. Backend APIs enforce RBAC - only users with settings:edit permission can create/edit/delete roles. Frontend correctly hides action buttons for users without permissions. Existing custom roles: QA Tester, Designer. Built-in roles: Super Admin, Org Admin, Project Manager, Team Member, Viewer.
